_comment: Copy to config/project-rules.json. A rule fires when ANY of its terms appears in the conversation, and manual rules outrank every other signal with full confidence. Keep terms distinctive — proper nouns, product names, jargon. A term like 'process' or 'best' will mis-file unrelated conversations and nothing downstream can override it. Do not paste your existing chat titles here: that encodes history, not a rule.

rules._comment: Use review instead of project to flag a topic for manual sorting.
